description: Backend persistence layer: SQLite database, inventory service, risk engine, score service, report service, and all new/extended API routes. This is the foundation all other features depend on. FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 both depend on this feature being complete.
steps: Step 1 — Rewrite backend/app/database/db.py. Replace the 3-line stub with a full implementation: (a) Compute DB_PATH using pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent.parent / 'data' / 'analyzer.db' so it always resolves to backend/data/analyzer.db regardless of CWD. (b) Implement get_connection() as a contextlib.contextmanager that opens a sqlite3 connection, sets row_factory=sqlite3.Row, executes 'PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON', yields the connection, then closes it. (c) Implement init_db() that creates a schema_versions table and all six entity tables using CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. Tables: schema_versions(version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TEXT), scans(scan_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, target_scope TEXT, scan_type TEXT, started_at TEXT, completed_at TEXT, status TEXT, error_message TEXT, limitations TEXT, host_count INTEGER), devices(device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, mac_address TEXT UNIQUE, last_known_ip TEXT, hostname TEXT, first_seen TEXT, last_seen TEXT, approval_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending_review', created_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT), device_observations(observation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scan_id TEXT REFERENCES scans(scan_id), device_id TEXT REFERENCES devices(device_id), ip_address TEXT, observed_at TEXT, host_state TEXT), port_observations(port_observation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scan_id TEXT REFERENCES scans(scan_id), device_id TEXT, target_ip TEXT, protocol TEXT DEFAULT 'tcp', port_number INTEGER, state TEXT, service_name TEXT, product TEXT, version_info TEXT, observed_at TEXT), security_findings(finding_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scan_id TEXT REFERENCES scans(scan_id), device_id TEXT, rule_id TEXT, title TEXT, severity TEXT, explanation TEXT, evidence TEXT, recommendation TEXT, created_at TEXT, dedup_key TEXT UNIQUE), scan_scores(score_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scan_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES scans(scan_id), score INTEGER, scoring_version INTEGER, provisional INTEGER DEFAULT 0, explanation TEXT, created_at TEXT). Create suitable indexes: devices(mac_address), device_observations(scan_id), port_observations(scan_id), security_findings(scan_id), security_findings(dedup_key). If schema_versions has no row for version 1, insert it with applied_at=now. Also create backend/data/.gitkeep (empty file) so the data directory is tracked in git without committing the DB file.

Step 2 — Create backend/app/services/inventory_service.py. Implement: normalize_mac(mac) -> str|None (uppercase, colon-separated, rejects broadcast FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF and empty/None). upsert_device(conn, ip, mac, hostname, scan_id) -> str: (1) if normalized MAC is not None, try SELECT device_id FROM devices WHERE mac_address=?; (2) else SELECT device_id FROM devices WHERE mac_address IS NULL AND last_known_ip=?; (3) if not found INSERT new device with uuid4 device_id, approval_status='pending_review', first_seen=now, last_seen=now, last_known_ip=ip, mac_address=normalized_mac, hostname=hostname; (4) if found UPDATE last_seen=now, last_known_ip=ip, updated_at=now, and hostname if new value is not None; (5) INSERT device_observations row; (6) return device_id. get_all_devices(conn) -> list[dict]. get_device_by_id(conn, device_id) -> dict|None. update_approval(conn, device_id, status) -> bool.

Step 3 — Create backend/app/services/risk_engine.py. Implement run_risk_engine(conn, scan_id) -> list[dict]. Load scan record. Load device_observations for scan_id joined with devices. Load port_observations for scan_id. Run four rules: (a) NEW_DEVICE_001 (severity='info'): for each device_observation where devices.approval_status='pending_review', emit finding. (b) SENSITIVE_PORT_001 (severity='high'): for each port_observation where state='open' and port_number in [21,23,2323,3389,5900,5901,69,161,162,512,513,514], emit finding. (c) POLICY_PORT_001 (severity='medium'): for each port_observation where state='open' and port_number in [22,80,3306,5432,6379,27017,1433,8080,8443], emit finding. (d) INCOMPLETE_SCAN_001 (severity='low'): if scan status in ('partial','timed_out','timeout','error'), emit one scan-level finding. For each finding, compute dedup_key = hashlib.sha256(f'{scan_id}:{device_id or ""}:{rule_id}:{port_number or ""}'.encode()).hexdigest(). INSERT OR IGNORE into security_findings. Return list of all findings for this scan (re-SELECT after inserts).

Step 4 — Create backend/app/services/score_service.py. Implement calculate_score(findings: list[dict]) -> dict: start=100, deduct high=-15, medium=-8, low=-3, info=0 per finding; clamp 0-100; provisional=True if any finding has rule_id='INCOMPLETE_SCAN_001'; return dict with score, provisional, explanation (e.g. '3 findings: 1 high, 1 medium, 1 low'), scoring_version=1. Implement save_score(conn, scan_id, score_dict) -> None: INSERT OR REPLACE into scan_scores.

Step 5 — Create backend/app/services/report_service.py. Implement build_report(conn, scan_id) -> dict: query scan, its device_observations joined with devices, its port_observations, its security_findings, and its scan_scores row; assemble into a single dict. Implement _sanitize_csv_cell(value) -> str: str(value); if starts with =, +, -, @, TAB, or CR, prefix with single quote. Implement build_csv(report: dict) -> str: use csv.writer with io.StringIO, write header then one row per combination of device + port + finding (repeat scan/device fields). Return getvalue() of the StringIO.

Step 6 — Modify backend/app/services/nmap_service.py to persist to DB while keeping in-memory stores. In run_host_discovery: (a) wrap entire DB section in try/except Exception so test mocks still work; (b) call init_db() and get_connection() inside a try block; (c) INSERT scan record with status='running' at start; (d) for each discovered host call upsert_device and INSERT device_observation; (e) UPDATE scan to 'completed' at end; (f) call run_risk_engine and save_score; (g) on exception paths UPDATE scan to 'error'/'timeout'/'partial' before re-raising or returning. Keep all existing _store_scan() and _devices[ip]=... calls in place — do not remove them. Do the same DB wiring for run_port_scan: INSERT scan record at start, INSERT port_observation per port result, UPDATE scan status at end, call risk engine and score service.

Step 7 — Create backend/app/schemas/device.py with DeviceDB (device_id, mac_address, last_known_ip, hostname, first_seen, last_seen, approval_status, created_at, updated_at all Optional[str] except device_id which is str) and ApprovalUpdateRequest (approval_status: Literal['approved','revoked','pending_review']). Create backend/app/schemas/findings.py with FindingOut (finding_id, scan_id, device_id Optional, rule_id, title, severity, explanation, evidence, recommendation, created_at all str fields). Create backend/app/schemas/report.py with ReportOut (scan: dict, devices: list[dict], ports: list[dict], findings: list[dict], score: Optional[dict]). Extend backend/app/schemas/scan.py: add completed_at: Optional[str] = None to ScanSummary; add ScanDetail(ScanSummary) that adds error_message, limitations, host_count, score.

Step 8 — Extend backend/app/api/devices.py: replace the existing GET /api/devices with a version that tries DB first (get_all_devices), falls back to nmap_service.get_devices() if DB fails or returns empty list AND in-memory has items; add GET /api/devices/{device_id} returning DeviceDB or 404; add PATCH /api/devices/{device_id}/approval accepting ApprovalUpdateRequest, calling update_approval, returning updated DeviceDB. Extend backend/app/api/scans.py: keep existing three routes; add GET /api/scans/compare (REGISTERED FIRST, before /{scan_id}) with query params scan_a and scan_b, returns diff dict; add GET /api/scans/{scan_id} returning ScanDetail from DB or 404. Create backend/app/api/findings.py: GET /api/findings with optional scan_id query param, returns list[FindingOut]. Create backend/app/api/reports.py: GET /api/reports/{scan_id} returns ReportOut; GET /api/reports/{scan_id}/csv returns StreamingResponse with text/csv content type and Content-Disposition attachment header.

Step 9 — Update backend/app/main.py: add lifespan context manager that calls init_db() on startup; change app = FastAPI(...) to use lifespan=lifespan; import and register findings.router and reports.router with prefix='/api'. Route registration order in main.py does not matter for shadowing prevention — that is handled within scans.py itself.

Step 10 — Add backend test files. Extend backend/tests/conftest.py with a tmp_db fixture: uses pytest's tmp_path, monkeypatches app.database.db.DB_PATH to tmp_path/'test.db', calls init_db(). Create backend/tests/test_database.py (idempotent init, FK enforcement, all tables exist, schema_versions=1). Create backend/tests/test_inventory.py (new device=pending_review, same MAC=same device_id, IP-fallback=separate devices, update_approval changes status). Create backend/tests/test_risk_engine.py (NEW_DEVICE_001, SENSITIVE_PORT_001, POLICY_PORT_001, INCOMPLETE_SCAN_001 triggers and non-triggers). Create backend/tests/test_score.py (empty=100, one high=85, floor at 0, provisional flag). Create backend/tests/test_reports.py (formula injection, 404 for unknown scan, csv content-type). Create backend/tests/test_comparison.py (404 for missing scans, diff keys present for seeded scans).

findings:
COMPLETED. Key facts for FEAT-002 and FEAT-003:

1. DB_PATH is computed as Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent / 'data' / 'analyzer.db' (resolves to backend/data/analyzer.db).
2. get_connection() is a contextmanager — use 'with get_connection() as conn:'. Foreign keys are ON for every connection.
3. init_db() is idempotent and safe to call repeatedly. Call it before get_connection() in any context that may run before app startup.
4. scans table uses 'target_scope' (not 'target') for the subnet/IP. The API GET /api/scans maps target_scope -> target in ScanSummary.
5. devices table: device_id (PK, uuid4), mac_address (UNIQUE nullable), last_known_ip, hostname, first_seen, last_seen, approval_status ('pending_review'|'approved'|'revoked'), created_at, updated_at.
6. GET /api/devices now returns DeviceDB schema (device_id, mac_address, last_known_ip, hostname, first_seen, last_seen, approval_status, created_at, updated_at) — NOT the old DeviceResponse schema. Frontend must use device_id and last_known_ip fields.
7. PATCH /api/devices/{device_id}/approval accepts {"approval_status": "approved"|"revoked"|"pending_review"} and returns DeviceDB.
8. GET /api/scans/compare?scan_a=X&scan_b=Y returns {scan_a, scan_b, devices_added, devices_removed, devices_common, ports_opened, ports_closed}.
9. GET /api/scans/{scan_id} returns ScanDetail: all ScanSummary fields + error_message, limitations, score (dict or null).
10. GET /api/findings?scan_id= (optional) returns list[FindingOut]: finding_id, scan_id, device_id, rule_id, title, severity, explanation, evidence, recommendation, created_at.
11. GET /api/reports/{scan_id} returns ReportOut: {scan: dict, devices: list[dict], ports: list[dict], findings: list[dict], score: dict|null}.
12. GET /api/reports/{scan_id}/csv returns text/csv with Content-Disposition attachment header.
13. nmap_service DB calls are wrapped in try/except so tests with mocked nmap still pass without a live DB.
14. Risk rules: NEW_DEVICE_001 (info), SENSITIVE_PORT_001 (high, ports: 21,23,69,161,162,512,513,514,2323,3389,5900,5901), POLICY_PORT_001 (medium, ports: 22,80,1433,3306,5432,6379,8080,8443,27017), INCOMPLETE_SCAN_001 (low, scan status partial/timed_out/timeout/error).
15. Score: start=100, high=-15, medium=-8, low=-3, info=0, clamped [0,100]. provisional=True when INCOMPLETE_SCAN_001 present.
16. All 80 tests pass (23 original + 57 new).
